enchantments.tooltip: Greater Poison Guard: This item carries a potent venom that may be contracted by enemies that hit you, dealing 2d6 Strength damage. A successful Fortitude Save (DC 28) will negate this effect.
Constitution +14: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Resistance +11: Passive: +11 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

Proof Against Poison +11: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +11 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 12 + their Fortitude save).
